### Husky

**Categories:** Software supply-chain security<br>
**Roles:** DevSecOps Engineer, Release Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Needs Review

Git hooks for Node.js projects (commonly paired with lint-staged).

**Use when**

**Consider alternatives when**

### pre-commit

**Categories:** Software supply-chain security<br>
**Roles:** DevSecOps Engineer, Release Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>

### Tekton Chains

**Categories:** Software supply-chain security, CI, build and testing<br>
**Roles:** DevSecOps Engineer, Release Engineer, Kubernetes Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Tekton controller that records, signs, and stores supply-chain metadata for pipeline task runs.
